messages:
maria.g: Heads-up — planning a controlled cutover tomorrow for the new SBOM sidecar + enclave attestation on the runtime images. Need to lock RBAC for the signer job, confirm KMS key wrapping (HSM path), and validate audit logs land in longterm-syslog. Anyone seeing conflicts?

jon.k: +1. what's the exact auth flow for the sidecar -> signer -> kms?

maria.g: Flow is: sidecar uploads SBOM to internal registry -> pipeline triggers `signer-service` job -> signer calls KMS (wrapped key) to cosign the artifact. Enclave (intel-sgx) provides local attestation proof which signer attaches as metadata.

irene.s: For RBAC we need to restrict `signer-service` to a dedicated SA with only `secrets/get` for the KMS token secret and `pods/exec` on the signing job if we keep ephemeral workers. No cluster-admin.

alex.r: Are we rotating the cosign key or using KMS-as-signer? The KMS integration path matters for audit logs and key exposure.

maria.g: We're using KMS-as-signer (asymmetric) with key policy locked to the signer-service SA via IAM binding. Cosign configured with `kms://gcp/...` style URL. We also need to enable key usage logging in KMS for every sign call.

sam.t: Quick note: build pipeline errored in staging when enclave flag was on — saw `attestation: unable to verify quote` in the pod logs. I pushed a flaky-retry to the job but want root cause before cutover.

maria.g: Paste the staging job log here?

sam.t: Sure:
```
2026-03-20T21:02:11Z signer-0 pod/sidecar-abc123: attestation: quote verification failed: missing CA cert
2026-03-20T21:02:11Z signer-0 pod/sidecar-abc123: falling back to soft-sign (NOT allowed in prod)
2026-03-20T21:02:12Z signer-0 pod/sidecar-abc123: sign attempt aborted
```

jon.k: That looks like the attestation root bundle isn't mounted in the staging image. We added a ConfigMap `intel-attest-roots` last week; maybe the volume mount name mismatch. I can PR a quick fix.

irene.s: While fixing that, also add an admission policy that denies `soft-sign` fallback in prod clusters. If attestation fails, pipeline must fail (no silent fallbacks).

alex.r: RBAC Q: who needs `iam.bind` on the KMS key? We should not give the buildkite/ci role direct key permissions. Bind only the `signer-service` SA and keep a small on-call group as audit principals.

maria.g: Agreed. Plan: 1) iam bind key -> signer-sa only 2) Enable KMS audit logs -> longterm-syslog 3) Admission controller to block soft-sign in prod 4) Fix ConfigMap mount in staging and re-run canary.

sec-bot: SECURITY ALERT: KMS key IAM policy change pending. Please ACK in thread and include ticket id for change review.

maria.g: ACK. I'll open ticket SEC-2026-493 and add the proposed policy JSON.

sam.t: PR for ConfigMap mount: https://git.internal/repo/pulls/784 — quick patch to `deployment.signer` volume name. Also added a readiness probe to fail fast if attestation root missing.

jon.k: Looking now. nit: change readiness probe exec to check `/etc/attestation/roots.pem` and return non-zero if missing. That will prevent fallback.

irene.s: For audit logging, we should also add a structured log field `signer.kms_key_id` and `signer.attestation_status` so queries can filter. Add to the signer-service log schema doc.

alex.r: One more: can we enforce cosign verification at deploy time? If we only attach signatures to registry blobs but not verify on node pull, we lose guarantees. We should integrate an image-pull webhook or admission plugin to verify cosign sigs and enclave claims.

maria.g: Yes — follow-up ticket to eng-platform to wire admission plugin (sigstore verification) for prod clusters. For tomorrow's cutover we will: do staging canary (3 nodes), verify logs, then schedule prod window.

sec-bot: REMINDER: Change window requires 48h SLA for rollback plan and runbook link. Add to SEC-2026-493.

maria.g: Added runbook section: how to rollback — revert `signer-service` deployment, remove KMS binding (revocation path), and mark images as unsigned in registry (quarantine tag).

sam.t: After the ConfigMap fix, staging canary passed local attestation. Re-running cosign sign step now.

jon.k: cosign command used in pipeline (for reference):
```
cosign sign --key kms://gcp/projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/cosign-key \
  --annotations attestation=\"$(cat /tmp/attest.json)\" gcr.io/redwood/runtime:sha256-abcdef
```

irene.s: Great. Action items: maria -> open SEC ticket + add policy draft; jon -> PR for readiness probe; sam -> confirm staging canary + upload logs to runbook; alex -> prepare admission plugin ticket. I'll owner-review the RBAC binding before change.

maria.g: Thanks all — I'll wait for jon/sam verification before scheduling prod cutover. :thumbsup:
